messages:
alex: Quick one — PR ready for the cut: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821
alex: Can someone take a quick look? Need approvals + changelog entry before the 18:00 PT cut.
sam: On it, pulling up CI now. Will do a light review (tests+smoke) in ~10.
sam: Small nit: unit test missing an assert, left inline comment. Also a doc link would be great.
alex: thanks, fixing tests & adding doc link.
maria: I can handle backports once merged. Which target branch? 2.3.x?
jen: Yes 2.3.x for the security patch train, 2.4 will be the main release. I'll add labels.
alex: changelog draft — can someone sanity-check wording?
```
- Added request bundling to inference runtime to reduce cost and latency (PR #4821)
```
jen: looks good, adding `changelog/next` + `release-note: feature`.
sam: CI flaky on gpu-integration earlier, rerunning the job now.
sam: CI is green on rerun, approving from my side. :thumbsup:
alex: awesome, thanks. I'll hold merge until 17:40 PT to give time for backports.
maria: after merge I'll run backport script and post results here. Command I'll use:
```
./scripts/backport.sh --pr 4821 --to 2.3.x
```
maria: also will run a quick smoke on the 2.3.x job after backport.
jen: tagging policy reminder: please ensure commit message includes "release-notes: included" so the release tool picks it up.
alex: updated commit message accordingly.
release-bot: Scheduled release cut for 2026-03-17T18:00:00-07:00 — release branch: release/2.4 (main -> release/2.4)
sam: looks good from perf side, no regressions locally.
jen: added the release tag and label. cut window confirmed.
release-bot: Merge queued: PR #4821 will be merged after approvals and CI at 1763306820.
release-bot: Merge completed: PR #4821 merged by alex into main at 1763306820.
alex: merged — thanks everyone. Maria, please paste backport output when done.
maria: backport completed, branch `backport/4821-2.3.x` created and tests passed. Pushed and opened backport PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4830
alex: perfect. I'll monitor the release dashboard for errors for the next hour.
jen: thanks all, will follow on release channel if anything pops up.
sam: :party-parrot:
